description: the man of the reference picture riding: a strong man heavenly avenger with short dark hair and a stern face, a ring of bright golden fire like a burning halo behind the head, heavy silver and white plate armour with gold trim and large round pauldrons, a long dark red tabard with a golden sun, a brown belt, a long white cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, silver greaves and boots, no sword and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the cloak and any long hair hanging down behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the top of the head to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same man, his face, hair, headwear, armour or robes, cloak and colours, drawn the same way; not his standing pose and not the burning sword
